name: hwp-tool
description: Read (merged-cell tables kept; HWP 3, PDF, Office and OCR via kordoc), edit, create and convert Korean HWP/HWPX documents from Claude: Markdown to report-style HWP, character and paragraph formatting, tables, headers, page numbers, footnotes, fields, merges, and exam-sheet layout. Works without Hancom Office for HWPX; when Hancom is installed it runs on a hidden desktop with no window on screen.
